newsitem.title: ITALY: CYCLING-SECOND GIRO STAGE WIN FOR CIPOLLINI AS RIVAL FALLS.
newsitem.headline: CYCLING-SECOND GIRO STAGE WIN FOR CIPOLLINI AS RIVAL FALLS.

text.p: Italy's Mario Cipollini snatched his second Giro d'Italia stage win in 24 hours as one of his chief rivals crashed on the final bend on Sunday.
Cipollini strengthened his grip on the lead as compatriot Nicola Minali crashed 200 metres from the finish of the 211-km second leg from Mestre.
Minali's back wheel skidded sideways as he chased Cipollini out of the final bend and Minali and Elio Aggiano slid into the spectator barriers.
Czech Jan Svorada pipped Endrio Leoni for second place with Cipollini comfortably clear at the line after a final lap averaging more than 50 kph.
Fabio Baldato, another Cipollini rival, had to fight back from an earlier crash on the 7.8-km circuit and was critical of the organisation for planning a course with so many corners.
